title: Bitcoin Movie Enigma

prize.note: single P2WPKH escrow, one funding transaction

target_format: BIP39 24 words (English), most likely BIP84 m/84'/0'/0'/0/i (script type v0_p2wpkh), no passphrase stated

derivation.summary: identify the 34 movies shown in panel order, transform each title into an English BIP39 word, drop 10 'intruder' words identified from an IMDb metadata field, and derive the resulting 24-word mnemonic to a P2WPKH address
derivation.certified_against: the public BIP39/BIP84 test vectors (12-word and 24-word 'abandon' vectors), since no solved sibling exists for this puzzle

difficulty_note: the derivation is bounded and fast once the inputs are known; all 34 films now have an identification (nine previously disputed panels were checked against the published stills on 2026-08-27 and follow the community list). A unique BIP39 4-letter prefix scan of each compact title yields a word for 33 of 34 titles; only The Goonies has none. The remaining gate is that Goonies word plus the IMDb field that drops 10 of the 34 words. Certificate G/PG/TV-14 was tested through the oracle (55,296 raw strings, 227 checksum-valid, 0 match, uncertified)

leads.title: find the title-to-word rule for The Goonies
find the IMDb field that splits 24 keepers from 10 intruders
re-check panels 9, 13 and 24 against the issue #9 sources

third_party_material: the 34 movie panels are individual frames from third-party films, not original material by the author; I do not reproduce them here and link to the author's still-live site instead
